headline: Weathered Expanse Bleeds Anew as Gutter Flags Trade Fiercely
war_summary: Since our last edition the storm has doubled back upon Weathered Expanse: after hours of easing, better than six hundred soldiers fell there in the two hours before this filing, and the flags keep changing — twenty-nine transfers on the day, three of its nine strongpoints still no-man's-land. Gutter remains the busiest flag market in the field, eleven more changes of hands in the past two hours and fifty-one in a day, Kuoppa again the pivot, with firing audible at the minute of writing. Palantine Berm keeps simmering, eight transfers in the same two hours, Vendett the storm-centre. The Nevish Line's flags have not moved since before dawn, yet its casualty ledger climbs steeply — nearly five hundred in that span, Colonial losses rising fastest. Callahans Passage, still without a single transfer, shows the heaviest day's toll of any front at some nineteen thousand, though its two-hour losses have fallen by roughly half. Godcrofts has stirred again with two late exchanges around Isawa and Argosa, while Marban Hollow and Stlican Shelf have lapsed back into quiet. The war stands in its 643rd day; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize.
